ModMetadata.Name: Smart Tooling
ModMetadata.Author: Mooka
ModMetadata.Description: [h1]Smart Tooling[/h1] Look at a structure and press one key: the mod takes the items and tools that structure needs out of your backpack, tool belt or uniform and puts them in your hands. [h2]Modes[/h2] [b]Construction[/b]: the kit/material and the tool for the next build stage (or for repairing / upgrading the structure). [b]Deconstruction[/b]: the tool that deconstructs the structure in its current stage. [h2]Hotkeys[/h2] X: select the items for the structure you are looking at. Shift+X: switch between Construction and Deconstruction. Ctrl+X: put the items back where they were. All hotkeys can be changed in the mod configuration (BepInEx/config/mooka.stationeers.smarttooling.cfg). [h2]Requirements[/h2] BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad. Client-side only: works in single player and on any server.
ModMetadata.InGameDescription: Look at a structure and press X to grab the items it needs. Shift+X switches Construction/Deconstruction, Ctrl+X puts the items back.
